info.title: API.SH: Meijer
info.description: The Meijer API from API.SH: public Meijer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One Meijer product by UPC (or product link) at one store: name, brand, link, description, features, details, ingredients, categories, images, store price, regular price, unit prices, sale flag and price text, savings, stock status, aisle locations, promotions, nutrition label, variants, sold-by unit, maximum order quantity, SNAP and WIC eligibility, delivery and pickup flags, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-product

parameters.name: upc
parameters.description: The product's UPC as Meijer shows it, or its product link.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Meijer store number the prices and stock are for (default 265; see /meijer/v1/stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Up to 50 Meijer products by UPC in one call, priced and stocked for one store (the search fields for each product). UPCs the shop does not know come back in `missing`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-products

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Meijer store number the prices and stock are for (default 265; see /meijer/v1/stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Meijer product's customer reviews with its average rating, rating distribution and recommended count. Each review: id, rating, title, text, nickname, reviewer location as shown, date, recommended flag, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and incentivized flags, photos, the shop's responses and secondary ratings. Filter by star rating; six sorts. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-reviews

parameters.name: upc
parameters.description: The product's UPC or product link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Reviews to skip (`next_offset` from the previous page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Meijer products by keywords or browse a category, priced and stocked for one store, with the shop's filters (values from `filters`), a price range and five sorts. Each product: UPC, product id, name, link, images, price, regular price, unit prices, clearance price, sale flag and price text, savings, sale end date, stock status, promotions, sold-by unit, mPerks, sponsored, WIC, delivery and pickup flags, plus `raw`. Also returns the filter options with counts and the matching categories. A keyword the shop sends to another page answers `redirect_url` and no items. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category group id from a search's `categories`, e.g. L1-865; alone it browses the category.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters as name:value pairs from a search's `filters`, comma-separated, e.g. brand:Meijer.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Meijer store number the prices and stock are for (default 265; see /meijer/v1/stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stock of one product at the Meijer stores near a place: each store's details with its stock status, aisle and unit price for the product.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-stock

parameters.name: upc
parameters.description: The product's UPC or product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Meijer store by number: address, phone, coordinates, type, format, services, opening date, market and region, store director, landmark, opening hours, store features and fuel station, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-store

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Meijer stores near a ZIP code or "city, state": store number, name, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, type, format, time zone and services (pickup, delivery and so on).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meijer-stores

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Store type code, as the shop uses it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
